source_hash_note: SHA-256 of the Git blob at source_commit.
host: Ubuntu VM in VirtualBox on a Ryzen 7 7840HS laptop
transfer_note: Copied from the VM to the Windows checkout on 2026-10-19. The two CSV files arrived named overhead_runs.csv.xls and overhead_net.csv.xls (an extension added during transfer); their contents are unchanged plain CSV text with LF line endings and were archived under their original names. Integrity checks at archival: all 24 runs status ok; overhead_net.csv recomputes exactly from overhead_runs.csv; overhead_summary.md regenerates byte-identically from overhead_runs.csv with the f47e288 tool. No hash of the files was recorded on the VM before transfer.
measured: Process CPU time (time.process_time and /proc/self/stat), context switches and RSS of the governor loop and a sleep-only control, on the VM.
interpretation_restrictions: Process CPU time, not electrical power or energy.
Measured inside a VirtualBox guest; not representative of native hardware.
Excludes CSV logging and terminal/dashboard rendering.
Derived CPU percent assumes the nominal tick rate; VM timer overshoot makes it an upper bound.
Frequency control was simulated; no hardware writes.
